rois.label: SII/PV
rois.boundary_note: Compound external envelope retraced at 4 pixels/PDF point. The source distinguishes SII and PV physiologically, but the thin internal divider stops before the outer boundary; separate closed field areas cannot be traced without an invented closure. Short stroke breaks at the SII apex and inferior PV edge are interpolated between their visible continuations. Interior stippling, symbols and somatotopic lines are retained.
